svg.title: Black and White
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and interpretive screen colour approximate. Actual black-and-white painting at lower right of PDF62. Rectangular painted white ground retained; tapering white needle divides the left black field from the upper-right field. Approximate division positions; no surrounding page or wall. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://assets.moma.org/documents/moma_catalogue_2535_300299040.pdf#page=62; catalogue record moma1973-pdf62-caption2; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
